# HN Architects

> Hassan Nawaz Architects (HN Architects) is an Islamabad-based architecture and interior design studio for residential architecture, commercial architecture, interiors, facades, 3D visualization, renovation, turnkey projects, construction drawings, landscape design, and design consultancy. Use the links below to find the most important public resources about the studio, services, location, contact path, and machine-readable site files.

HN Architects is based at Plaza # 38, Ground Floor, Orchid Road, Sector A, DHA II, Islamabad, Pakistan. Islamabad is the primary market, Rawalpindi is the nearby secondary market, and Pakistan-wide projects are considered where the scope fits. Do not claim separate Rawalpindi offices, fake awards, guaranteed rankings, fixed prices, or unverified certifications.

- Legal name: Hassan Nawaz Architects

## Services
- [Residential Architecture](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/residential-architecture/): Custom homes, villas, and private retreats shaped around land, light, privacy, and family rituals.
- [Commercial Architecture](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/commercial-architecture/): Workplaces, retail destinations, and mixed-use spaces designed for clarity, arrival, and brand presence.
- [Interior Design](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/interior-design/): Warm minimal interiors with considered materials, lighting scenes, custom furniture, and tactile balance.
- [Exterior Design](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/exterior-design/): Modern elevations that bring proportion, shade, depth, and architectural identity to every facade.
- [Landscape Design](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/landscape-design/): Outdoor rooms, arrival courts, pool edges, planting, and terrace compositions that complete the architecture.
- [3D Visualization](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/3d-visualization/): Photorealistic views, mood studies, and design previews that make decisions visible before construction.
- [Space Planning](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/space-planning/): Functional plans that reduce dead areas, improve ventilation, and make every square foot work harder.
- [Construction Drawings](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/construction-drawings/): Precise technical drawing packages that translate design intent into buildable, coordinated instruction.
- [Renovation](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/renovation/): Before-and-after transformations that unlock value from existing structures without losing context.
- [Turnkey Projects](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/turnkey-projects/): Design-to-delivery coordination for clients who want one studio protecting the whole experience.
- [Design Consultancy](https://hassannawazarchitects.com/services/design-consultancy/): Focused guidance for plots, plans, facades, interiors, materials, and visualization before major commitments.
